notes: THE FOOTAGE WORKS FROM THE FIRST MOMENT OF A RUN. Until now the footage started only when the voice stage itself ran: a Run whose voice was already recorded fetched no footage until the check had finished its whole Whisper pass. Now the footage starts beside the first long stage the Run actually runs - the voice, or the check when the voice is done (the console says alongside the verify stage, the page running beside verify) - and only a Run where nothing runs before it fetches the footage in its own place. Since 1.3.75: every search of a folder runs at once, and every folder line of the clips log says where its seconds went.
